:::{#def-radian}
#### Radian

A **radian** is a unit for measuring distance along the [unit circle](#def-unit-circle),
chosen so that going once round the circle is a distance of $2\pi$ (@def-pi).
A trip covering the [fraction](algebra-sums.qmd#def-fraction) of the circle $f$ has the distance in radians $d$:

$$
d = 2\pi f.
$$

:::
